description: THE SLOW RISE property (M4 keystone, worlds/tortoise/rise_sequence.gd), driven by --rise (dev/capture force-arm, fires ~3s after load regardless of dream count -- RISE {"phase":"start","forced":true}). No input needed for the first ~29s: both Pip and Otto sit at spawn until the sequence bubble-lifts them (core/rescue/bubble_effect.gd, no receipt of its own -- watch for the absence of RESCUE lines instead) to the meadow skirt and holds them there through the whole ~12s rise + 3s hold + 8s settle + 3s tail. Expected receipts, in order: RISE phase=start (forced:true); phase=reward_ground_solid (the crown-nook reward's collision goes live FIRST, before any camera/tween work -- the established lesson every prior keystone's own header documents); phase=petals; phase=risen (after the 12s rise); phase=settling; phase=settled (after the 8s settle); phase=end (forced:true). Zero RESCUE lines throughout -- both seats float to the meadow and hold, never fall. PHASE 2 (teleport-assisted, ~30s in, well after phase=end -- same allowance marmalade_stretch.json's own Phase 2 used): both seats teleport onto the 'Highest Bloom' reward platform (29.0, ~11.91 top surface -- measured via a throwaway reward_top_point() probe) and hold for 3s, proving the crown reward -- built hidden at boot, revealed the moment the rise starts, permanently in place afterward -- is solid, reachable ground at its own post-rise position. Both seats move together on purpose: core/coop/seat_manager.gd's own frustum leash would otherwise snap a lone teleported seat back to its partner (the same established lesson marmalade_stretch.json's own header documents) -- core/** is out of this pass's territory to touch.
